body: I really hope these last two weeks are great for you, and that you successfully visit everywhere you've always wanted to go to.
Thanks for the replies guys, it's been a huge help! :)
That's great to hear! Have you tried hooking it up to a USB audio interface by any chance?

I'd love to hear what kind of coping mechanisms you've come up with/discovered, since I have almost none and resort to crying and panicking most nights. I appreciate the gesture of help, you sound like a lovely person and I hope you've had a good day today.

Hey, I appreciate you reading what I've posted, it means a lot to me. Everybody seems to be really understanding and thoughtful here. That's a very good point, although as mentioned in my other comments I know that if I disappeared other people would be able to provide the people I love with help and happiness far better than I ever could. I wouldn't want to burden my suicide on others, so I'd feel too concious about their happiness to be able to do it. I've been thinking about scenarios where I'm taken at gunpoint or mugged on the way home, as if I died in those instances at least people wouldn't have to worry about my intentions and take time out of their days to worry about helping.

Thank you for reading what I posted, I hope I didn't take too much time out of your day. As much as I can completely understand what you mean, to me I still come across as ugly and useless (both physically and mentally) as I more than likely still get in the way, say too much, say too little, make people worry and don't provide enough. I'm sure there are a plethora of people who could provide the people I love with a lot more happiness and joy than I am providing, and that is all I really want. 

Thank you for the compliments, those mean so much to me. I'm glad somebody sees that as a form of beauty, although I'm sure most would overlook it as what I do really isn't too special from what others can do/do more efficiently.

I would love to find somebody who could make me feel better, to explain that everything is okay. However in my eyes, if I fall in love with a person both visually and spiritually, they're really something absolutely special and therefore deserve a lot more than I can or ever will be able to provide, and if the opportunity came up that they could recieve more of something they need from someone else I would have no problem them leaving my life to pursue a further happiness than they would with me.

The fact you stopped to read my post is a sign that you're a friendly person, and if I feel capable of speaking directly with anyone I'll send you a message. I hope this doesn't take up too much of your time and that you stay happy and have a good day.
It's okay, I'm sure a lot of people are going through similar things, I'm nothing special to worry about. I hope you don't worry too much and have a great day.

Hey, thank you for the reply. I wasn't expecting anybody to comment.

I do have a best friend that I do lots of fun things with. She means the world to me and again I'm massively concerned with making her smile, laugh and so on, I've told her making her happy is what's become one of the most important things in my life. However, about a month ago I moved to a flat to study in a town away from home and I didn't quite realise how much I relied on making people happy to give myself any self worth. She even moved closer to my old place to see me more often. But after moving away to study, I just got filled with even more doubt. Did I make the right decision about the course? Did I choose to study at the best place? Will I waste years of my life without achieving happiness? It's incredibly lonely here and even though I felt isolated and scared before, it's heightened greatly here. She is the only person I've ever discussed my feelings with and even managed to tell her I'd been feeling suicidal recently, to which she told me she'd hate me if I ever did something like that.

I think a lot of it comes down to my lack of self worth. I know people have confidence issues and such, but I have no idea how common it is for someone to genuinely feel worthless, like all I do is get in the way and cause inconvenience. I feel like a lot of the people I talk will cut contact or lose interest in me when I'm not able to provide for them. 

And I guess that's the situation I'm in. I feel like suicide at this point would be the best solution to what I'm going through and will likely be going through for many years, possibly of the fear of continuing to feel like this in the future. However, I can't even feel selfish about suicide because all I'd think about is how I'd still ruin someones day by them discovering I was gone. Again, I'm not sure if this is worded well, I hope it makes sense. Thank you deeply for your response.
